name: serpapi_yelp_search
description: Find restaurants, coffee shops, bars, and other local businesses using Yelp results through SerpApi. Use when Yelp ratings, review counts, price tiers, categories, review snippets, or Yelp filters such as DogsAllowed and GoodForKids matter. The default is Yelp's recommended order; rating and review_count sort the complete returned page locally because Yelp's explicitly sorted response can omit business details. Results include names, Yelp links, stable place IDs, ratings, review counts, price tiers, neighborhoods, open-state labels, categories, and snippets when Yelp returns them. This search does not guarantee street addresses or full operating hours; use a maps or web search tool for those. One normal search uses one SerpApi request; include_reviews uses one additional request for the selected or top result.

find_desc.description: What to search for on Yelp, such as Coffee, pizza, ramen, brunch, or dog friendly restaurants.

find_loc.description: Location like New York, NY, USA. Defaults to JARVIS_DEFAULT_LOCATION when omitted.

attrs.description: Optional Yelp attrs filter string or list. Example: GoodForKids,DogsAllowed or Smoking.no.

sort_by.description: Result ordering. Defaults to recommended. rating and review_count sort the returned Yelp page locally so business details remain complete.

dogs_allowed.description: If true, automatically appends DogsAllowed to attrs.

place_id.description: Optional first Yelp place ID selecting which business to use when include_reviews is true. Search results expose this value.

include_reviews.description: Fetch review excerpts for place_id or the top result using one additional paid SerpApi request. Use only when the user asks for actual review content.

review_limit.description: How many reviews to return when include_reviews is true. Clamped to 1..10. Default: 3.

num_results.description: How many search results to return. Clamped to 1..10. Default: 5.

no_cache.description: If true, bypass SerpApi cache for fresh fetch.

extra_params.description: Additional SerpApi Yelp parameters passed through, excluding reserved keys.

include_raw.description: Include raw SerpApi payloads for debugging. Default false.

availability.setup_hint: Set SERP_API_KEY in the active mode env file.
